verdict.rationale: Authy is an authenticator app, so organizing many tokens is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the pack documents search, folders or groups, or service icons. The only related item is a user complaint about having to 'search the boxes' and asking for alphabetization, which points to weak organization rather than a documented feature.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away
